Context: While creating ADR 00011, the assistant used direct file edits (Read/Edit) to author an ADR's Decision/Consequences content and only reconciled that back through `adr_sync`/`adr_link`/`adr_generate_toc` after being explicitly told to. This wasn't a one-off lapse: nothing in the MCP surface states the intended workflow up front. Each tool (`adr_new`, `adr_sync`, `adr_link`, `adr_set_context`, etc.) documents its own contract reasonably well, but there is no equivalent to an onboarding call (the kind of thing a caller invokes once at the start of a session to learn "how work gets done here") - a caller has to reconstruct the overall workflow from individual tool descriptions, or from reading the tool's own source, neither of which is reliable.
Title: Explicit workflow guidance for MCP tool callers (adr_workflow_guide)
